headline: Gutter Settles to Colonial Colors as Kuura Strand Burns and East Cools
war_summary: Since the last edition the Gutter has been settled: its seven works now stand wholly Colonial, and the two-hour action count there has fallen from seven to two, though ninety-one actions were logged across the day. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's furnace — fifty-one actions in the day, three in the past two hours — its lines unchanged at four Warden, three Colonial and two unclaimed works, with 6,728 Colonial and 8,151 Warden casualties in the day. The eastern eruptions have banked: Olavis Wake and Pari Peak, both alight overnight, report three and one actions respectively in the past two hours. Fresh heat instead appears at Kuura Strand, where 371 Colonial and 218 Warden fell in two hours and Martti passed to Colonial hands; five of its six works remain Warden. Marban Hollow stays lively, five actions in two hours around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. Callahans Passage bears the heaviest day's toll, 7,477 Colonial against 5,841 Warden, without a work changing hands. Colonials now hold 317 works to the Warden 114, with five unclaimed.
